Router and dispatcher cleanup swallowed erasure failures.
Immediately after startup an empty model-provider cache could leave durable resume history untouched.
changes: Move team-router SQLite erase off-loop and propagate failure after provider fan-out.
Erase durable resume history independently of a populated provider cache.
Acknowledge a Telegram confirmation before awaiting the host; render its outcome as plain text.
